read_first: The export files are ragged: 31 of 40 rows this week and 29 of 35 last week have 22 cells under the 21-column header. In most the 22nd cell is empty and nothing changes, but in five Lost rows this week (D8009, D8010, D8020, D8024, D8025) the Lost date is in the 22nd cell, so the entered_lost column is empty, and in D8005 the date meant for Pilot proposed lands under Partner said yes. This check reads each cell under its header, as 3.0 names the fields, and gives no meaning to a cell past the last column. D8005, D8009 and D8010 keep the key's reasons either way; D8020, D8024 and D8025 become H13. See alternative_reading for what a realigned reading would give; the key is wrong under either.
